verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a way to set retention periods or delete customer, case, screening or transaction data. The closest items are adjacent features: data export by date range, unmonitoring customers, and a 5-second TTL on export download URLs, which is a fixed link expiry rather than user-controlled retention. None of these lets a user control how long data is kept or delete it, so this applicable privacy axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
